increment_paragraph: **SP10-FORMAL-BINDING-DESCRIPTIONS (2026-11-23).** User decision 2026-11-20 (conditions are symbols, not sentences); user 2026-11-23: "Launch both" (the two SP7 follow-up cards). A binding manifest's and a flow model's environment components are typed environment references, never English descriptions: the canonical JSON list of G01p parameters {name, sort} (the encoding the bindings already used for quantifiers), nonempty and strictly increasing by name, each a bound typed atom's parameter in the same sort or a registered term in its rendered sort, or a content digest for exact bytes held elsewhere. A formal binding names a qualified proposition and its quantifiers and conclusion are exactly its typed atom's parameters and formula. The new qcore_contract::formal_binding refuses anything else with the new diagnostic QF005 on every load route (hypothesis_bindings::resolve, resolve_bounds, resolve_model and premise_flow::compile, compile_bounds, compile_model), fail-closed. A reference asserts no condition: the retired descriptions' Open qualifiers are SP7's never-derived #source_corresponds (the cJSON detach environment, the user's E2) or the new #binding_source_corresponds. A new SP10 block of 22 rendered terms (Rust RENDERED_TERMS, which gains function sorts; specification table; Lean sp10Terms) covers what no bound atom quantifies: the correspondence, #held_context, the three property views and the cJSON hook/list and frame/API/pointer-forgery components of QCore.PluginPremiseDecomposition's environment. The 22 distinct descriptions of the 167 live manifests (166 rk_plugin_callback_closure, 1 detach_list_representation; 1835 values) were rewritten by premise_formula_binding_refresh --environment-descriptions, the descriptions each manifest's only change, with the 167 markers patched in seven librdkafka modules and every consumer repointed; the code-built environments of cjson_local_binding and plugin_source_witnesses and the test and example fixtures state typed references, digests and derived bindings. The legacy reader lifts each recorded description (lift_environment) and sp2_premise_checkpoint writes this card's marker edits back first. Lean QCore.FormalBindingEnvironments (audited) gives each SP10 term its meaning (sp10_terms_denote), proves every recorded reference resolves and every plugin and detach atom parameter is covered, that the correspondence is never derived, and binds environmentVectors to the Rust ENVIRONMENT_DECISION_VECTORS. Spec C04.18.2, C04.18.3, C04.18.9 (SP10 block), the grammar note beside C04.18.2's, rule 13h and the diagnostics page were updated. A marker is a module comment outside every contract text, so no contract_sha256 changed and no re-pin was needed: contract-inventory.lock and contracts.json record the seven module digests and the 167 manifest references only. Binding manifests stay evidence-only: no move is predicted on any route.

ledger.why: DISCHARGED by SP10-FORMAL-BINDING-DESCRIPTIONS: every environment component of the 167 live binding manifests and of the code-built flow models (cjson_local_binding, plugin_source_witnesses, test and example fixtures) is a typed environment reference over bound atom parameters and registered SP7/SP10 terms, or a content digest; every formal binding's quantifiers and conclusion are its typed atom's parameters and formula. English is refused with QF005 on every load route; the manifests were migrated with their digests and markers; Lean QCore.FormalBindingEnvironments proves every recorded reference resolves. No verdict moved (predicted).

ledger.title: State the cJSON native-domain receipt's interpretation strings symbolically
ledger.text: Recorded by SP10-FORMAL-BINDING-DESCRIPTIONS. quirin-source-analysis::cjson_local_binding's native-domain receipt (the checked case JSON) carries English ownedChild_interpretation, next_prev_interpretation and trace_interpretation strings and the slugs universal_atoms / no_writer_trace. They are not a binding environment or a formal binding, so QF005 does not cover them. DISCHARGE: each a typed reference to the terms the receipt's cases instantiate (or removed where the receipt's checks already state it), the receipt digest and its consumers migrated, no verdict moved. Size: small.

ledger.title: Retire or re-target the two historical binding producers
ledger.text: Recorded by SP10-FORMAL-BINDING-DESCRIPTIONS. crates/qcore-contract/examples/plugin_binding_catalog.rs reads a frozen design (docs/reports/plugin-premise-decomposition) whose environment components are English and string-atom inputs the format has refused since SP6, so its check mode now refuses (QF002/QF005); quant_binding_migration copies environments from the manifests it migrates and now refuses an English input. Neither is run by a test. DISCHARGE: remove both (their reports keep the command records), or re-target them to typed inputs with a replay test. Size: small.
